subject: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Tom Lee <tlee@apex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 4:02 PM PDT
Subject: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST

Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock a 90-minute technical deep-dive with your architects and our solutions team to walk through inference routing, KV cache behavior across long sequences, and a short routing/fallback demo. Given the cross-region attendees (SF, London, Bangalore) we hit daylight-savings shifts in some slots, so I wanted to propose a couple of concrete windows and ask whether we should split into two 45-minute sessions instead.

Quick ask: which of these works for your architects? If none, tell us two contiguous 60-min blocks that work and we’ll adapt. We’ll include an agenda and a short pre-read.

Option A (single 90-min block):
- Thu Jun 10, 8:00 AM PDT / 11:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM BST / Fri Jun 11, 8:30 PM IST

Option B (two 45-min blocks, same day):
- Block 1: Thu Jun 10, 7:30 AM PDT / 10:30 AM EDT / 3:30 PM BST / 9:00 PM IST
- Break 30 min
- Block 2: Thu Jun 10, 9:00 AM PDT / 12:00 PM EDT / 5:00 PM BST / 10:30 PM IST

Note on DST: the UK is currently on BST (UTC+1) and US is on DST (UTC-7 for PDT), whereas IST is constant. I converted to local times above but can provide an exact UTC window if helpful.

Attach: tri-region-agenda.pdf (short agenda + ask list).

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.example.com

---

From: Tom Lee <tlee@apex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@apex.com>, Apex Solutions Architects <arches@apex.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 19:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST

Ben —

Appreciate the options. Our architects are tight next week: Priya and I checked calendars. Two quick constraints:
1) Bangalore team (Priya + two architects) prefers not to be later than 10:30 PM IST on weekdays.
2) Our London lead can start as early as 3:00 PM BST, but prefers to avoid 5:00 PM BST on Thursdays.

Given that, Option B looks close but Block 2 at 5:00 PM BST is uncomfortable for London. Could we shift blocks earlier by 30 minutes? That would put Block 1 at 3:00 PM BST and Block 2 at 4:30 PM BST, which keeps London within preferred window and Bangalore under 10:00 PM IST.

If splitting is not workable for your engineers, we can try a single 60-min overlap on Fri Jun 11 that hits early morning PST and late evening IST — but that reduces time for the demo.

Happy to align; shout if you want me to propose specific UTC times.

Tom
Tom Lee
Head of Solutions, Apex Financial
tlee@apex.com

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Tom Lee <tlee@apex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 20:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST

Thanks — good constraints to know. Marissa / Karthik, can the SRE/infra deep-dive content slide 30 minutes earlier so Block 1 starts at 7:00 AM PDT / 10:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM BST / 8:30 PM IST and Block 2 at 8:30 AM PDT / 11:30 AM EDT / 4:30 PM BST / 10:00 PM IST? That would meet Tom's asks (London avoids 5 PM BST, Bangalore ends by 10 PM IST).

Marissa: we’ll need the extended KV cache walkthrough in Block 1 and the routing/fallback demo in Block 2. Karthik can own latency-troubleshooting Q&A at the top of Block 2.

If you both are OK I’ll send a calendar invite with two 45-min slots and a 30-min break.

Ben

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Tom Lee <tlee@apex.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 01:12 AM BST
Subject: Re: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST

On Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 8:05 PM PDT Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik, can the SRE/infra deep-dive content slide 30 minutes earlier so Block 1 starts at 7:00 AM PDT / 10:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM BST / 8:30 PM IST and Block 2 at 8:30 AM PDT / 11:30 AM EDT / 4:30 PM BST / 10:00 PM IST?

Yes — that works for me and for the demo environment team. Two notes:
- Please confirm whether the customer will want the KV cache replay enabled (it extends session setup by ~8 minutes). If so, we should shorten Block 2 slightly or move the technical Q&A to a follow-up.
- I’ll need a diagram of the customer’s expected sequence-length distribution ahead of time so we can tailor the cache examples. If Apex can drop a short CSV (sample latencies/seq-lens), I’ll bake it into the slides.

Otherwise I’m good for the earlier slide.

Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com

---

From: Tom Lee <tlee@apex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@apex.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 09:21 AM IST
Subject: Re: Tri-Region Deep-Dive — overlap windows & DST

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks, that schedule works. We’ll provide a 500-row sample of sequence lengths and average latencies by EOD Mon Jun 7 (Priya will drop to the Drive link).

Ben — please send the calendar invite (two 45-min sessions with a 30-min break) and the agenda PDF. Marissa — KV replay: we can enable it, but only if you shorten Block 2 by 5 minutes. That’s fine from our side.

Confirming attendees on our side: Priya Singh (lead, Bangalore), Ankit Rao (infra architect, London), Sarah Nolan (data platform, NY).

See you Thu Jun 10 (Block 1: 07:00 PDT).

Tom

---

[Attachments included in final message: tri-region-agenda.pdf (agenda / roles / ask list), deep-dive-bridge.ics (calendar invite)]
